tokens.agreement_verdict: on hotpotqa the retriever step is the larger point estimate at 5 of 5 dial levels, and the fitted curves never cross; on nq the generator step is the larger point estimate at 4 of 5 dial levels, and the isotonic fit gives g* = 0.10 [0.00, 0.78]; 1665 of 10000 resamples censored.
